facts.statement: Members with a Station Account in good standing on or before May 2, 2011 received an extra 45 days of Member time added to their account.

article_summaries.title: Welcome Back to Free Realms!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's welcome-back post for lapsed players returning to Free Realms (dated only relatively as "2 months ago" on the capture, so about May 2011). It describes a returning-player bonus of 45 extra Member days for accounts in good standing on or before May 2, 2011, or 20,000 Coin for Lifetime Members, plus a seven-day login gift series of free items, with an extra Lonely Island Lot for Lifetime Members.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE welcome-back news post for returning players. It describes login-based gifts: extra play time and membership days for returning members who updated their Station account before a cutoff, 20,000 coins for lifetime members, and a seven-day free-item login reward. The post gives no absolute date, and the cutoff date is garbled in the source.
